title.zh: 【Solana Mobile dApp Store 出现恶意应用，目前团队已移除】
title.en: 【Solana Mobile dApp Store 出现恶意应用，目前团队已移除】

current_state.zh: Solana Mobile removed a malicious 'SKR Claim' dApp that requested users' seed phrases after unauthorized access to its dApp publishing portal and tampering with the Spotlight and Quests interfaces.
